studios.s1: Draft a multi-location New Year campaign
studios.s2: Draft a class description for Slow Flow
studios.answer: Occupancy rose at Queen West (+6 pts) and Leslieville (+3) versus September. Shoreditch is flat and Surry Hills is down 2 pts. Kitsilano can’t be compared: its booking sync has been degraded since 09:40 local time. I can’t tell why attendance changed from occupancy alone.
studios.assumptions: Compared Oct 1–13 with the same days in September, in each studio’s own time zone.
studios.actionTitle: Draft “New year, new practice” campaign for 3 Canadian studios
studios.excluded1: London, Berlin, Sydney (not in campaign scope)

sports.s0: Suggest a fix for the Pitch 2 clash
sports.answer: Move U12 Camp to Pitch 1 at 17:00 (free until 18:30), or shift U10 Blue to 16:00 at Hillcrest Dome. Both only affect those two groups. I won’t select or move participants — that stays with your coaches.
sports.assumptions: Uses venue bookings for today at Riverside Park, Pacific time.
sports.actionTitle: Draft notice to U12 Camp guardians about the pitch change
sports.affected0: U12 Camp · 22 guardians at Riverside Park

wellness.s0: Draft a reply using our cancellation policy
wellness.answer: Draft: “Hi Jordan, you can move your appointment free of charge up to 24 hours before. I’ve found Thu 17:00 with Rina if that suits.” I didn’t use any intake form details.
wellness.assumptions: Cancellation policy v2 applies to Harbourfront. Intake form responses are excluded from AI context.
wellness.actionTitle: Send reply to Jordan P. by email

commerce.s1: Draft copy for Canvas tote from its spec sheet
commerce.s2: Which stores failed the last sync?
commerce.answer: Linen overshirt L sold 9 units at Portland in 7 days against 3 the week before; stock is 1. Merino crew is flat. This is based on WooCommerce orders only; in-store sales aren’t connected, and Austin is excluded while disconnected.
commerce.assumptions: Revenue is reported per currency (USD, CAD, EUR) and never combined.
commerce.actionTitle: Draft reorder note for Linen overshirt L at Portland

foods.s1: Draft menu copy for the flatbread
foods.s2: Plan a lunch promotion across Seattle
foods.answer: Ballard so far: 14 Ember bowls, 8 brisket sandwiches, 6 flatbreads, 11 lemonades. Fremont is missing because its kitchen screen is offline, though orders still arrived there. I can’t change prices, dietary labels or order acceptance.
foods.assumptions: Counts orders accepted since opening, Pacific time.
foods.actionTitle: Draft “Weekday lunch” promotion for Seattle locations

realty.s0: Summarize viewing feedback for 42 Birchmount Cres
realty.s1: Draft a description for Suite 1806 from its facts
realty.s2: Who should I follow up with this week?
realty.answer: Three viewings at 42 Birchmount Cres logged feedback: two rated it 4–5 and liked the kitchen and garden; one raised the basement ceiling height. One buyer asked about closing dates. I only used the logged feedback — buyer identities were not shared with me.
realty.assumptions: Feedback from completed viewings in the last 14 days, Toronto time. No-shows are excluded.
realty.actionTitle: Draft follow-up emails for 2 interested buyers
